      01 / A QUICK HELLO
      
        A tiny site.A happy start.
        Every big project begins somewhere. This one's intentionally simple: a friendly mascot, a clean layout, and a few places to add things later.No real name, email, location, or social accounts are shown here. That can stay exactly as it is until you choose otherwise.
      
    

    
      02 / SPACE TO GROWA little of everything.Three blank spaces for whatever you want to share. No pressure to fill them today.
      
        01 / PROJECTS↗✳Things I makeA future home for little projects, experiments, and ideas.COMING TO LIFE SOON
        02 / NOTES↗✎Things I learnA place for notes, discoveries, and the occasional happy accident.WORDS WILL GO HERE
        03 / JUST FOR FUN↗🥕Things I loveA friendly reminder that websites don't always need to be serious.MORE FUN AHEAD
      
    

    
      03 / ONE LAST THING
      That’s allfor now. ✳
      A small start is still a start. Come back when you're ready to add your own projects, writing, and personality.
